newsitem.title: POLAND: LDA prices planned rights at PLN 8.
newsitem.headline: LDA prices planned rights at PLN 8.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish printing house Lodzka Drukarnia Akcydensowa SA (LDA) have set the price of a planned rights issue of 650,000 to 1,383,440 common shares at eight zlotys, the company said in a statement.
LDA also said it would offer 271,530 registered preferred shares with the voting power of five common shares to the firm's current registered preferred shareholders at six zlotys.
The firm said both sets of shares would be offered as one-for-one rights. @
LDA shareholders also approved a planned issue of 1,000 three-year convertible bonds at a nominal value of 10,000 zlotys to a group of investors to be chosen by management.
It said the bonds would have a 10-percent annual coupon and be convertible into 1,250,000 shares at a price not lower than eight zlotys.
LDA said it would have a 12-percent call option on the bonds 18 months after their issue or if the firm's share price eclipsed 15 zlotys.
The firm's shares closed on the Warsaw bourse's parallel market on Friday at 13.6 zlotys. @
It said the issue was aimed at forming capital links with other companies, boost sales and broaden product assortment.
